transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because… I just don’t seem to feel much of anything good anymore. Even when my children come sit with me, or the sun is nice on the garden, I feel flat inside. Like that part of me that could feel glad or comforted has just… shut off.
Have you noticed that things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or time with family, no longer bring you pleasure or interest?
Yes… I suppose so. My children can be right there with me, or I’ll sit looking out at the garden in the sun, and I just feel… flat. Like I can’t really take any comfort or gladness from it anymore.
Do you find yourself feeling down or having little energy most days?
I don’t know… maybe some days. I haven’t really kept track. I just feel sort of worn out, I suppose.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty or like you’re not worth much lately?
I… don’t know. I haven’t really thought of it that way. I suppose I just feel worn down, but… not sure about guilty or worthless.
Have you felt down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
I’m not really sure. I do feel low at times, but… most of the day, nearly every day? I can’t say that for certain.
Would you say that most days, you feel down or depressed for most of the day?
I’m not sure I’d say most days… I do get low, but I don’t really know if it’s most of the day.
Would you say that on most days, you feel down or depressed for most of the day?
I… I don’t really know how to measure that. Some days I feel low, yes, but saying most of the day, most days… I’m not sure.
Let’s try to clarify this. Would you say that on a typical day, you feel down or depressed for the majority of the time you're awake?
I don’t think I can say that. I feel low off and on, but… majority of the day awake, I’m not sure.
On how many days per week would you say you feel down or depressed for at least half of the day?
I’m not really sure… maybe a few days? I haven’t been keeping track of it like that.
Can you think back over the past two weeks—on how many days would you say you felt down or depressed for most of the day?
I’m not sure… I can’t really put a number on it. Some days, yes, but most of the day… I don’t know.
How long have you been feeling this way overall?
About two weeks now… since my husband collapsed, and the paramedics were working on him in our kitchen.
Have you noticed a decrease in your interest or pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy, such as hobbies, time with family, or being in the garden?
Yes… I suppose so. Even when my children sit with me, or I’m by the garden in the sun, I just feel… flat. Like I can’t really feel glad or comforted the way I should.
Can you tell me if on most days, you feel down or depressed for most of the time you're awake?
I… I don’t know if I’d say most of the time. It comes and goes. I haven’t really been keeping track.
Can you tell me if on most days, you feel down or depressed for most of the time you're awake?
I’m sorry… I really can’t say. Some days it feels like it’s there a lot, but I haven’t been watching the clock or anything.
Can you tell me if, on most days, the low or depressed feeling lasts for the majority of the time you're awake?
I’m not really sure. It feels heavy some days, but I can’t say if it’s most of the day… I haven’t been keeping track like that.
Can you tell me if, on the days when you feel low or depressed, the feeling usually lasts for most of the day?
I can’t really tell. When it comes on, it feels like it hangs around, but… I don’t know if it’s most of the day or not.
Can you tell me if, on most days, your low or depressed mood is present for the majority of the time you're awake?
I don’t know how to answer that. It’s there sometimes, but I can’t really say it’s most days or most of the day.
Can you tell me if on more than half of the days in the past two weeks, you felt down or depressed for most of the time you were awake?
I’m sorry, I really don’t know. I haven’t been counting the days like that… it comes and goes, and I can’t say if it was more than half.
Can you tell me if, over the past two weeks, there have been more days when you felt down or depressed for most of the day than days when you didn’t?
I’m not sure. I know I’ve felt down at times, but I couldn’t say whether it was more days than not.
Can you tell me if, over the past two weeks, there were more days when you felt down or depressed for most of the day than days when you didn’t feel that way?
I don’t think I can say that for sure. Some days I’m low, yes, but… I haven’t really kept track enough to know which kind of day was more.
